children: Singapore, September 02, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has assigned a Ba3 long-term foreign currency senior secured rating to the senior secured USD notes issued by Capri Global Capital Limited. The notes are issued under Capri's US $1.0 billion global medium term note program, which is rated Ba3. The rating outlook is stable.

title: Moody's Ratings assigns Ba3 to Capri Global Capital's GMTN drawdown
